# DELTREE

DELTREE is a local-only macOS menu-bar utility for understanding and safely managing disk space created by Codex-driven iOS and macOS development.

## Key Documents

- README: ./README.md
- Privacy policy: ./PRIVACY.md
- Safety policy: ./docs/SAFETY.md
- Architecture: ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- CLI diagnostics: ./docs/CLI.md
- Release process: ./docs/RELEASING.md
- Release QA: ./docs/RELEASE_QA.md
- Homebrew plan: ./docs/HOMEBREW.md
- Support workflow: ./docs/SUPPORT_WORKFLOW.md
- Icon pipeline: ./docs/ICON.md
- Documentation index: ./docs/INDEX.md

## Useful Commands

- Full local check: `make check`
- SwiftPM core tests: `make swift-test`
- Xcode tests: `make test`
- Release dry run: `make package-check && make appcast-check`
- Safe diagnostics: `Tools/deltree diagnose --json`

## Guardrails

- No telemetry or remote upload of scan data.
- No permanent delete path in v1.
- Cleanup defaults to Trash or approved simulator commands.
- Public distribution requires Developer ID signing, notarization, Sparkle signing, and clean-machine QA.
